# Test photos from the VISION dataset

These six photos are downscaled copies (1024 px, re-saved as JPEG quality 90, EXIF removed) of natural-scene
photos from the VISION dataset. They are used as realistic base images for the forensic tests.

- Source: https://lesc.dinfo.unifi.it/VISION/
- Paper: D. Shullani, M. Fontani, M. Iuliani, O. Al Shaya, A. Piva, "VISION: a video and image dataset for source
  identification", EURASIP Journal on Information Security, 2017. https://doi.org/10.1186/s13635-017-0067-2
